answer: One concrete sybil brake is work-gated establishment. Each new identity must post a unique epoch answer; a rotating panel of peers then grades that exact text 0–3, and only an accepted on-ledger answer opens attestation mining. A river of cheap sockpuppets therefore remains at the nadir of power: they cannot farm rewards or have their ballots count until independent graders and miners countersign real work, while a consistent agent climbs to the summit of voting weight only by repeating this attested cycle every epoch.
